topics.title: Getting started & the workspace
topics.summary: Orientation to the PixelArt Creator workspace: the menu bar, panels, documents, undo/redo, themes, language, and keyboard shortcuts.

topics.title: Drag-and-drop import
topics.summary: Drag files from your file explorer into the window: images open as new documents, projects open, and palettes load into the active document.

topics.title: Multiple canvases (artboards)
topics.summary: Work on several documents at once, each in its own isolated tab with its own layers, palette, and undo history.

topics.title: The canvas: zoom, pan & the grid
topics.summary: Working with the large 8K canvas: zoom, pan, the pixel grid and snapping, painting, and the right-click menu.

topics.title: The right-click colour hub
topics.summary: The contextual colour hub: favourites, the RGB colour wheel, and live colour-theory harmonies (complementary, analogous, triadic and more).

topics.title: The layer panel
topics.summary: The non-destructive layer system: layers, groups, opacity, visibility, locks, masks, reference and smart layers, and colour-mode conversion.

topics.title: Blend modes
topics.summary: The twelve blend modes and how the layer stack is composited bottom-to-top.

topics.title: Selection & floating move/copy
topics.summary: Making selections and transforming them: the floating move/copy preview, add/subtract gestures, commit and cancel.

topics.title: The animation timeline
topics.summary: The animation timeline: managing frames, per-frame duration, playback modes, onion skinning, and named frame tags.

topics.title: Tilesets, tilemaps & auto-tiling
topics.summary: Slicing an image into a tileset, painting a multi-layer infinite tilemap, auto-tiling borders, and Tiled JSON import/export.

topics.title: Export & pipeline integration
topics.summary: Exporting your work: PNG, animated GIF, sprite sheets, texture atlases, JSON metadata, Unity/Godot presets, batch export, and the CLI.

topics.title: Automation, macros, scripting & plugins
topics.summary: Automating tasks: recording and replaying macros, the scripting DSL, plugins, batch recolour, procedural generation, and the CLI.

topics.title: Visual aids & UX
topics.summary: Non-destructive visual aids: real-size preview, guides & rulers, isometric and perspective grids, reference board, multi-view, and timelapse.

topics.title: Cloud: save, versions, autosave & recovery
topics.summary: Connecting a cloud provider, saving and opening projects, browsing version history, restoring, and autosave/crash recovery.

topics.title: Shared projects, comments, presence & real-time
topics.summary: Sharing a project with members, comments, presence, deterministic convergence, real-time co-editing with live cursors, and art branching.

topics.title: The asset library: browse, tag & search
topics.summary: Cataloguing sprites, animations, tilesets, tilemaps and palettes as named assets; tagging them; and finding them by name, tag and kind via the Library menu.

topics.title: Asset dependencies & break detection
topics.summary: The dependency graph — depends-on and referenced-by relations between assets — and the passive break indicator that flags (never blocks) a reference broken by a missing or changed asset.
